name: Aelnir Metadata Cleaner
summary: See what your photos reveal, then save a clean, verified copy. Originals stay untouched.
tagline: See what your photos carry, from location and dates to camera and software, then save a new, verified copy without it. Your originals are never touched.

features.title: Know what you share
features.lead: Cleaning never uses the network. The privacy logic runs on your phone.

items.title: See what's inside
items.body: Location, dates, camera and device, software, author, descriptions, XMP, IPTC and embedded thumbnails, shown before you share.

items.title: Presets that fit
items.body: Remove Location, Privacy Clean (the default), Remove All Supported, or Maximum Privacy, which re-encodes the pixels. Or pick categories yourself.

items.title: A new copy, verified
items.body: Every output is opened again and checked before it is saved. The original photo is never modified.

items.title: Pixels left alone
items.body: JPEG, PNG and WebP are cleaned without touching a pixel. HEIC, AVIF, DNG and TIFF are inspected where your phone can read them and cleaned by re-encoding.

items.title: History without the data
items.body: History keeps counts and category names only, never the metadata values themselves.

items.title: Many at once
items.body: Clean several photos in one go instead of one at a time.

strip.label: Cleans
strip.text:
JPEG · PNG · WebP, pixels untouched
HEIC · AVIF · DNG · TIFF, by re-encode

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Ads pay for it. Your photos stay put.
note.body: Aelnir Metadata Cleaner is free and supported by ads. Your photos are never uploaded, and cleaning never touches the network.

studioProof.hard: Every cleaned photo is opened again and verified before it is saved. The privacy engine runs without Android or a network.
